before_seq.description: Return only runs with a `seq` below this value — the next, older page. Send back the `next_cursor` of the previous response rather than computing one.

limit.description: How many runs to return, from `1` to `200`. Absent means `100`. It arrives on the query string, so a numeric string and a number are both accepted.

robot_id.description: Only runs on this robot. Absent means every robot in the organisation.

slug.description: Only runs of this action or service.

state.description: Only runs in this state — `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `lost`.

from_ms.description: Only runs that started at or after this unix timestamp in milliseconds. Together with `to_ms` the window is half-open, `[from, to)`, so adjacent windows tile without counting a run twice.

to_ms.description: Only runs that started **before** this unix timestamp in milliseconds. The window is half-open, so a run starting exactly on `to_ms` belongs to the next one.
